description_target.ambiguity_notes: The extension is not a full 2-D tiling: every glyph appears across the first lattice row, but only every third horizontal instance continues downward.
negative_constraints: Do not extend the color-7 instance columns downward.
Do not recolor non-third horizontal instances.
Do not infer a stride independent of the glyph bounding box.
solution_steps: Find the bounding box of the color-7 glyph.
Use glyph width plus one and height plus one as the horizontal and vertical lattice periods.
Repeat the glyph in every horizontal slot of the first lattice row.
Recolor horizontal slots 2, 5, 8, ... to color 6 and repeat only those slots down later lattice rows.
Clear all cells outside the selected copies.
description_target.source: canonical program and public train/test pairs
description_target.target_text: Repeat the color-7 glyph across the first row of a one-cell-gap lattice. Every third horizontal instance (indices 2, 5, 8, ...) becomes color 6, and only those color-6 instance columns repeat downward.

racket_target.raw_code: (rule! (lambda (g) (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))) (begin (define bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 7))) (define r0 (first bb)) (define c0 (second bb)) (define r1 (third bb)) (define c1 (fourth bb)) (define gh (+ 1 (- r1 r0))) (define gw (+ 1 (- c1 c0))) (define hstep (+ gw 1)) (define vstep (+ gh 1)) (define (mask? local-r local-c) (= (safe-at g (+ r0 local-r) (+ c0 local-c) 0) 7)) (define (paint? r c) (if (or (< r r0) (< c c0)) #f (let* ((rr (- r r0)) (cc (- c c0)) (local-r (mod rr vstep)) (local-c (mod cc hstep)) (inst (quotient cc hstep)) (row-rep (quotient rr vstep))) (and (< local-r gh) (< local-c gw) (mask? local-r local-c) (or (zero? row-rep) (= (mod inst 3) 2)))))) (cellmap g (r c v) (if (paint? r c) (if (= (mod (quotient (- c c0) hstep) 3) 2) 6 7) 0))))))
